intent.proves: No item-based page lacks its item instance.
intent.scope: non-deleted pages with an item type; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(PageId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + PageItemType FROM Page WHERE PageDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(PageItemType, N'') <> N'' AND ISNULL(PageItemId, N'') = N''
